answer: Each identity carries one plume: a chained credential where each epoch's real job is stamped and linked to the last, so no fake can insert a backdated proof. The plume lives only if the identity emits a pulse each epoch - a fresh hash of one real job - echoed by a different counterparty that epoch. An echoed fake burns both bonds: the identity locks 85,000 POA, the echoer stakes 40,000 POA, half to the reporter, identity banned 13 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 85,000 = 85,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one bond once. The limit: a pulse dies if its counterparty is offline.
